subject: Request: one-time sandbox uplift and timeline amendment for TruHarbor evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@truharbor.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: TruHarbor Procurement <procurement@truharbor.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: additional sandbox tokens + 2-week timeline shift

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team is excited about the API performance. We’ve completed initial integration and want to run a short, targeted evaluation against production-like traffic for a couple of extra tests (latency stress + prompt-sweep).

Two asks:
- A one-time uplift of 75k sandbox tokens (we burned through the allocation quicker than expected).
- A 2-week extension to the evaluation window (now ends Dec 1; would like to extend to Dec 15) to finish procurement signoff.

Procurement is still routing our PO; they asked if Redwood can cover the runway for these two weeks and we’ll reconcile on signature. I’m attaching the SOW draft and our current usage dump so you can see consumption.

Would you be able to approve this or point me to the right contact? We’re hopeful this extra runway gets us across the signature finish line.

Appreciate it —
Jordan
Jordan Price
Head of Product, TruHarbor Analytics
--- Attachment: TruHarbor_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)
--- Attachment: truharbor-usage-report-nov.csv (csv)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@truharbor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: additional sandbox tokens + 2-week timeline shift

Jordan —

Thanks for the detail and the attachments. I pulled the usage report — makes sense why you ran through the allocation. I can authorize a temporary runway, but anything beyond our standard self-serve limits needs one-time approval from Deal Desk / Revenue Ops. I’ve looped in Ben (Sales Ops) and Lauren (Legal) to confirm any contract addendum needs.

Proposed plan:
- I’ll request a one-time 75k token uplift valid only for the sandbox project id you sent.
- If procurement is delayed beyond Dec 15 we’ll need a signed addendum that covers the extended window; Legal can prepare a short amendment and Procurement can sign.

Ben / Lauren — can you confirm alignment? Ben: is there room for a one-off credit in this case tied to the signature milestone? Lauren: any objections to an addendum that states: interim credit for sandbox, reconciled upon PO execution?

Jordan — I’ll stand by while we confirm internally and circle back by EOB Pacific today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@truharbor.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: additional sandbox tokens + 2-week timeline shift

Vanessa / Lauren —

I’ve reviewed TruHarbor’s usage and the ARR potential on this deal (DEAL-8753). The short answer: I’m comfortable recommending a one-time sandbox uplift tied to a clear repayment/PO milestone. Proposed guardrails:
- 75k tokens one-off sandbox uplift, expiration Dec 15, 2026.
- Credit is contingent on signed PO for minimum committed tier (per our pipeline notes) within 14 days of Dec 15.
- If signed PO not received, we retroactively invoice TruHarbor for consumed tokens beyond standard free allocation.

I’d like Aditya to sign off on waiving the usual approvals for the token uplift and confirm any exception to our standard credit policy.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 10:05 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
> ...
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@truharbor.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: additional sandbox tokens + 2-week timeline shift

Thanks everyone for the context. I reviewed the deal economics in the linked HubSpot record and the ARR outlook. Given the close timeline and TruHarbor’s strategic fit (analytics + platform integration), I approve a one-time sandbox uplift under these explicit conditions: 

1) 75,000 sandbox tokens provisioned immediately and disabled on 2026-12-15 at 23:59 PT unless a signed PO or addendum is received earlier.
2) Contract addendum drafted by Legal (Lauren) stating the interim credit and the reconciliation path (invoice if PO not executed). Addendum must be signed by TruHarbor Procurement and countersigned by Redwood before Dec 22 to avoid retro billing.
3) Technical scope lock: uplift limited to sandbox project id: truh-prod-eval-874 (no cross-account transfer).
4) Sales will not bill until reconciliation window closes; Deal Desk to submit a follow-up invoice if reconciliation fails.

Ben: please process the uplift and update Deal Desk record with a note about the token id and expiration. Lauren: please draft the short amendment and drop it in the HubSpot deal. Vanessa: confirm to Jordan once uplift is live.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@truharbor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: additional sandbox tokens + 2-week timeline shift

Jordan —

Good news: Aditya approved the uplift with the conditions outlined below. I’ve provisioned the 75k sandbox tokens to project id truh-prod-eval-874 and set an automatic disable on 2026-12-15T23:59:00 PT. You should see the tokens reflected in the Console within ~10 minutes.

Lauren is drafting the short addendum now and Ben will attach the Deal Desk note and follow-up invoice template to the HubSpot record. To keep things moving on your side, please: 
- Sign the addendum once you receive it (Procurement) or reply with the PO if it clears earlier.
- Confirm you received the uplift by sending a short acknowledge reply so we can close the internal loop.

Thanks for the quick coordination. Hope this helps bridge procurement and keep the evaluation momentum.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
